content.title: Who is Bryce James' girlfriend Sadie Johnson? All about LeBron James’ son’s romance
content.text: Bryce James and girlfriend Sadie Johnson. Image via: Jerome Miron-Imagn Images | sadiej0hnson/ InstagramBryce James has not logged meaningful minutes yet for the Arizona Wildcats, but his name continues to circulate for reasons beyond the court. The young guard remains a long-term project in Tucson, still developing his game at just 18. Off the court, though, his personal life has started to draw attention, especially his relationship with Sadie Johnson.Their connection has quietly grown over time. From early appearances to subtle social media hints, the two have moved from speculation to something rather visible. It is still low-key, but there is enough there for fans to take notice.All about Bryce James' girlfriend, Sadie Johnson Bryce James and Sadie Johnson. Image via: Getty Images Sadie Johnson is a college student based in California, reportedly studying marketing at the University of California, Berkeley. While Bryce remains in Arizona, the distance has not slowed things down.The two first caught public attention during the 2024 Paris Olympics. They were seen together alongside Bryce’s family, including LeBron James, as Team USA competed. From there, moments began to surface. A short clip at a theme park, likely Disneyland Paris, showed the pair sharing a relaxed, comfortable vibe that felt more than casual.Social media has filled in the gaps since. In one post from San Francisco, Johnson captioned a photo, “sf day🌸”. Bryce responded with a simple but telling comment, “Mine😍”. Sadie Johnson bonds well with LeBron James' family Sadie Johnson and Zhuri. Image via: @NBACelebsUpdate/X What stands out is how naturally Johnson seems to fit into the James family circle. She has been spotted alongside Savannah James, Bryce’s younger sister Zhuri, and Bronny James during group outings.At the Olympics, LeBron acknowledged both young couples, greeting them before the game and later including them in a private celebration after Team USA’s gold medal win. There have been lighter glimpses too. A TikTok featuring Johnson and Zhuri dancing together quickly gained traction, offering a look at the ease between them. Certainly, the duo makes each other complete.Bryce James met with Sadie Johnson's fatherBryce himself has shared a rare look into the relationship. During a livestream appearance, he reenacted how he introduced himself to Johnson’s father, trying to show respect while keeping his composure.“Hey, Mr. Smith, doing good? Yessir,” Bryce started the video. “I love everything you doing, I see you loving your daughter. She looks great. Just, you know, I’m a great guy. Love to get to know you more…”The moment turned slightly awkward when others jumped in, but the intent was clear. Bryce was trying to do it the right way.For now, the relationship remains young and mostly private. But between public appearances, family moments, and small glimpses online, it is clear that the duo is still going strong.
